suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as association risk. Require separately established celiac disease and schizophrenia; use only as association evidence and establish chronology independently. Meta-analysis supports higher population-level risk but not causation, aggravation, or a biological pathway in an individual. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Celiac Disease and Schizophrenia
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes
Qualified clinical opinion before using population-level evidence as an individual nexus
